# A struct spread writes each field of its operand that is not its zero value,
# on every language alike, whether the build folds the spread or merges it at
# run time.
#
# With a Style's unset fields at their zero, `{display=flex, ...style}` lays a
# caller's Style over a component's look: the caller's unset fields leave the
# look's. A field written after the spread is the literal's own.

mkdir none html bubbletea android

cp app.sngl none/app.sngl
sngl test --platform=none none/app.sngl
stdout 'ok +5 tests, 0 failures'

cp app.sngl html/app.sngl
sngl test --platform=html html/app.sngl
stdout 'ok +5 tests, 0 failures'

cp app.sngl bubbletea/app.sngl
sngl test --platform=bubbletea bubbletea/app.sngl
stdout 'ok +5 tests, 0 failures'

cp app.sngl android/app.sngl
sngl test --platform=android android/app.sngl
stdout 'ok +5 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

enum Tone { unset, calm, loud }

struct Look {
    pad  option[int]
    w    int = 4
    tone Tone
    name string
}

var held Look = {w=0, tone=Tone.loud}

func over(o Look) Look {
    return {pad=8, w=9, tone=Tone.calm, name="look", ...o}
}

func testLiteralOperand(t test.Test) {
    var p Look = {pad=8, w=9, tone=Tone.calm, name="look", ...Look{w=0, name=""}}
    t.assert(p.pad == 8)
    t.assert(p.w == 9)
    t.assert(p.tone == Tone.calm)
    t.assert(p.name == "look")
}

func testOmittedDefault(t test.Test) {
    // w's declared default is 4, which is not int's zero: the spread writes it.
    var p Look = {pad=8, w=9, ...Look{}}
    t.assert(p.pad == 8)
    t.assert(p.w == 4)
}

func testHeldOperand(t test.Test) {
    var p = over(held)
    t.assert(p.pad == 8)
    t.assert(p.w == 9)
    t.assert(p.tone == Tone.loud)
    t.assert(p.name == "look")
}

func testSetFieldsWin(t test.Test) {
    var p = over({pad=2, w=3, name="mine"})
    t.assert(p.pad == 2)
    t.assert(p.w == 3)
    t.assert(p.tone == Tone.calm)
    t.assert(p.name == "mine")
}

func testWrittenAfter(t test.Test) {
    var p Look = {...held, w=5, tone=Tone.unset}
    t.assert(p.w == 5)
    t.assert(p.tone == Tone.unset)
}

ui.window {
    ui.text(value="{over(held).w}")
}
